programme_facts.value: Prepare to become a Licensed Professional Counselor with Arizona State University’s online Master of Counseling. This clinically intensive program combines coursework and supervised clinical hours through a chosen local field placement in your area. Designed to meet Arizona licensure requirements, this program is approved by the Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners as leading toward LPC licensure in Arizona and delivered through ASU’s School of Counseling and Counseling Psychology.
